decision_conditions:
<p>Prior to the first
occupation of any of the flats hereby approved, the refuse and recycling
storage facilities shown on Drawing No. 2611/02 Rev A (Landscaping Plan, June
2026) shall be provided in full and thereafter retained and kept available for
refuse and recycling storage purposes.</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
landscaping scheme shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved
Landscaping Plan (Drawing No. 2611/02 Rev A, dated June 2026) within the first
planting season following the date of this permission. Any trees, shrubs or
plants which, within a period of five years from the date of planting, die, are
removed, become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next
planting season with others of a similar size and species, unless otherwise
agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p>Prior to the first
occupation of any of the flats hereby approved, the cycle parking facilities
shown on Drawing No. 2611/02 Rev A (Landscaping Plan, June 2026) shall be
provided in full and thereafter retained and kept available for cycle parking
purposes.</p>

<p>Within three (3)
months of the date of this permission, the boundary treatments comprising
timber fencing within the rear gardens and the brick wall along the front
boundary, as shown on Drawing No. 2611/02 Rev A (Landscaping Plan, June 2026),
shall be provided in full and thereafter retained and maintained.</p>

<p>The development hereby
approved shall be operated and maintained to achieve a maximum water
consumption rate of no more than 105 litres per person per day, as set out in
the Sustainability Statement (116 Nibthwaite Road, Harrow, dated 7 June 2026),
and shall be retained as such thereafter.</p>
